text.div: Matched members group - members authorized for provider access
Non-matched members group - members not found in payer system
Consent-constrained members group - members who opted out of Provider Access API

200.description: Export request created successfully. Use Content-Location to poll status.

issue.diagnostics: The request has been created successfully. Polling Location is present in the 'Content-Location' header.

get.description: Performs a health check to validate the availability and operational status of the FHIR Provider Access.

200.description: Service is healthy - If the API engine is working correctly and if the entry points are accessible, the API operating status response shows "OK".

500.description:
Service is unhealthy
- **Note:** If you receive a response other than 200 OK, the health check failed. Please submit a ticket with Optum.
